messages.subject: Re: recordTable issue
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kevin,
R can find the files in the directory, hence all those file names are returned. Exiftool seems to be installed correctly and the system can find it.
But exiftool cannot access the information in the sample images (hence the warning message and no output). To my knowledge, status 2 means that the system could not find the specified file (see here <https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/ms681382(v=vs.85).aspx>).

But in your sessionInfo it says you run R 3.3.3, whereas the sample images (and camtrapR) are in the library of R 3.4.4. Are you running R in RStudio? If so, can you change the version of R that is run by default to 3.4.4 (Tools - Global Options - General) and see if it changes anything?
If you run R as a standalone program, does it make a difference whether you run version 3.3.3 or 3.4.4? Do you get the same error in both?

I'm sorry, this is mostly guesswork. I don't understand the issue yet.
Best,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: using count information
messages.body_plain:
Dear Jürgen, dear Jim,

It seems that this question was left open. As I'm facing the same issue as Jim (if I understood it well), I would like to elaborate on it. The function detectionHistory is really great to create object that can be used further on in unmarked. However it is limited so far to detection histories, i.e. 1/0 value. In the case where information on the group size is available (in my case e.g. extracted visually by operator from video analysis), would it be possible to create in the same way as detection history, a similar table but with exact count rather than binary value? Such table could then be used for example in unmarked (pcount,...) and to my view strengthen the relation beween camtrapR and unmarked.

Hope it helps to make progress on this question.

Best,

Kevin
